In this paper, we are interested in evaluating the visual capacities of pre-trained language models; in our case, BERT. To do so, we choose the Visual Question Generation (VQG) task ... We introduce BERT-gen, a text generator based on BERT, that can be applied both in mono and multi-modal settings.

Human Evaluation To get more in-depth understanding of our models, we report human assessment results ... We asked 3 human annotators to assess the quality of each question using a Likert scale ranging from 1 to 5, for the following criteria: readability, caption relevance, and image relevance.

We asked 3 human annotators to assess the quality of each question using a Likert scale ranging from 1 to 5, for the following criteria: readability, measuring how well-written the question is; caption relevance, how relevant the question is w.r.t. to the caption; and, image relevance, how relevant the question is toward the image.
